product.title: Half Day Guided Tour of Olympic National Park

description.text: The glacial mountains, coastal rainforests, and wilderness of Olympic National Park lie about a 2-hour drive west of Seattle. With this tour, make your own way to Port Angeles, then set out on a guided minivan tour to the glacier-carved valley Lake Crescent. After admiring the views, enjoy an about 3-mile hike through the ancient forests to another natural wonder—Marymere Falls.

highlights: Visit two popular viewpoints in Olympic National Park
Hike up to three miles to Marymere Falls
Hassle-free round-trip transport from Port Angeles
Intimate small-group tour with a maximum of 14 people
